SELECT br.reservation_id, br.user_id, br.book_id, br.reservation_time, br.invalid_time, br.reservation_status, br.remind_status, bi.book_name, bi.cover_url, bi.author, bi.translator, bi.deleted as bi_deleted, bc.category_code, bc.category_name FROM book_reservation br LEFT JOIN book_info bi ON br.book_id = bi.book_id LEFT JOIN book_category bc ON bi.category_id = bc.category_id WHERE br.user_id = #{userId} AND br.reservation_status IN (0, 1)
AND ( bi.book_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') OR bi.author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') )
AND bc.category_code = #{param.categoryCode}
ORDER BY br.reservation_time
